name: OpenCode Quota
author: caopengfei
description: OpenCode Go subscription quota in a compact panel: rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowance left, with reset times. Read-only, one endpoint, English and Simplified Chinese.
safetyNotes: Read-only. It calls exactly one endpoint (GET opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage) with an OpenCode Go API key that you paste into this plugin's settings, and only while the active provider is an OpenCode Go one — with any other provider the panel shows no numbers and makes no request. It never reads chats, transcripts, project files, or PI-Desktop's own provider secrets; the key stays in this plugin's local settings file on your machine and is sent nowhere else.
changelog:
0.3.0 — Compact single-row layout, and the last-refreshed time now sits in the header just before the refresh button. Removed the provider subtitle and the endpoint footer.
0.2.0 — English and Simplified Chinese, following the system locale; language can be pinned in the plugin settings.
0.1.0 — First release: rolling, weekly and monthly OpenCode Go quota with reset times.

settings.title: OpenCode Go API Key / API 密钥
settings.description: Create one at opencode.ai/console → Account → Personal API keys. Stored in this plugin's local settings file.
